description: Task 5: matched evaluation of the SFT, RLVR and RLAIF policies. The policy family, prompt set, decoding configuration and length cap are identical across conditions; only the feedback source used for training differs.

verifier_judge_agreement.definition: Over response pairs for the same problem where the exact verifier assigns different rewards, the fraction of pairs the AI pairwise judge prefers the verifier-correct response.
